international.title: China, Russia and US agree peace declaration with no mention of Ukraine and Iran wars
international.summary: Xi, Putin and Trump outline priorities that include UN reform, boosting oil supplies and ‘protection of diplomatic immunity’ Apec summit – latest updates China, Russia and the US have said they have agreed a peace statement after an unprecedented trilateral summit, but the declaration made no mention of the wars in Ukraine and Iran triggered by two of the participants. The declaration on Thursday also outlined a set of priorities that included changing the UN, boosting oil supplies and what it said was the protection of diplomatic immunity. Continue reading...
